name: 24901 · Lewisburg, WV
findings: ZIP 24901 (Lewisburg) has 84 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 24901 (Lewisburg) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
34% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 24901 (Lewisburg) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).
